name: Misrata
desc: Major port and industrial city in Tripolitania, known for its economic influence.

name: Al Bayda
desc: One of the key cities in the Green Mountains, surrounded by fertile agricultural land.

name: Zawiya
desc: A major city west of the capital featuring a highly developed petroleum industry.

name: Zliten
desc: Coastal city on the Mediterranean, famous for its Islamic educational centers and mosques.

name: Sirte
desc: A strategically located city in the middle of the Libyan coastline on the Gulf of Sirte.

name: Tobruk
desc: Important port city near the Egyptian border, featuring a deep natural harbor.

name: Ajdabiya
desc: A central crossroads connecting the coastal region with the desert hinterland.

name: Derna
desc: A picturesque eastern city known for its green surroundings and water springs.

name: Sabha
desc: The largest city in the Fezzan region and the historical center of the southwest.

name: Khoms
desc: A coastal city east of Tripoli, in close proximity to the ruins of Leptis Magna.

name: Bani Walid
desc: Centrally located in a desert valley, it is the stronghold of the Warfalla tribe.

name: Al Jawf (Kufra)
desc: One of the most isolated cities in the world, located in a massive desert oasis.

name: Marj
desc: An agricultural city built upon the ruins of the ancient settlement of Barca.

name: Tarhuna
desc: A high-altitude agricultural city renowned for its vast olive groves.

name: Zuwara
desc: Small port city in the northwest where traditional Berber culture is still maintained.

name: Gharyan
desc: Central mountain city in the Nafusa Mountains, famous for its underground cave dwellings.

name: Sabratha
desc: Modern coastal city located directly adjacent to an important ancient theater.

name: Al Jamil
desc: A growing city in the western part of the country, near the Tunisian border.

name: Surman
desc: A quiet coastal community nestled between Zawiya and Sabratha.

name: Yefren
desc: A significant mountain town deeply rooted in the traditions of Berber culture.

name: Nalut
desc: The westernmost major town of the mountain region, known for its well-preserved ancient granary.

name: Murzuq
desc: An oasis town deep in the southwest, once a major center of the trans-Saharan trade.

name: Awbari (Ubari)
desc: An important hub in the Sahara, famous for the surrounding sand dunes and lakes.
